sections.gui.scm: 1b. Color schemes: color aliase:
Colors are named by alias: titlebar_bg, text_fg, card_border, bar_fg ...
The value of an alias, the first found wins:
  1. a color given to the call itself (a number, "#rrggbb", rgb(r, g, b))
  2. the app's theme.css (in its folder), the block of the scheme in use
  3. the system's /spiffs/theme.css (theme-css, API 1.8), the same block
  4. the app's own defaults (theme-defaults!)
  5. the built-in day or night scheme (THEME-DAY, THEME-NIGHT)
When none of them names the alias, the same steps for its category, the
part after the last "_" (titlebar_bg -> bg, text_sub_fg -> fg,
card_border -> border). A value is #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb(r, g, b) or
another alias, so names of your own work too:
  day   { my_orange: #f08c32; warning_fg: my_orange; }
  night { titlebar_bg: #152030; }
  *     { seg_on_fg: #6fcf7f; }        (every scheme)
  sakura { bg: #fff4f6; }              (a scheme of your own)
The mode (config.ini [theme], an app's own config.ini may override):
  theme        auto (default), day or night
  theme_switch light (default: light-lux at or over theme_light_day is
               day, at or under theme_light_night night), time
               (theme_day_start .. theme_night_start) or sun (sunrise to
               sunset at theme_lat / theme_lon; the time when unknown)
  theme_day / theme_night  the scheme each mode uses: day / night, or a
               block of theme.css of your own
The theme-* colors above are set from the aliases at the start and again
whenever the mode or a theme.css changes (theme-tick!, from the app loop).
sections.applib.scm: 9. Alerts (强提醒):
Something that needs the user now (a dose due, a new message) takes the screen over the
pages: (app-alert! key title render [opts]). The alert with the highest priority shows
(1..9, 9 the highest; equal ones in the order they came); a higher one raised meanwhile
goes in front, and the one it covered comes back after it with the seconds it had left.
While one shows the carousel stops, a short press confirms it (its ack runs, then it
closes) and a long press puts it off for a few minutes. How it ends: button (a short
press), time (after its seconds), both, or app (only the app's own (app-alert-done! key),
e.g. once every dose is taken; a short press still runs its ack). The user's settings
come first: a combined app's alerts setting for the member (combo.scm), then the app's
own alert (0: none of its alerts), alert_priority, alert_exit (button, time, both),
alert_seconds, alert_snooze (minutes); then the options the app passes; then 5 / both /
30 s / 5 min. opts: an alist of (ack . thunk), (priority . n), (exit . symbol),
(seconds . n), (snooze . minutes), (full . #t) (render draws the whole screen, its own
title bar and hints: the medicine reminder). key: a string the app picks (one per message, per
dose time); raising it again updates the alert; an alert that ended is not raised again
under the same key until the app restarts.
(app-watch! url-proc interval-ms proc): a feed fetched in the background at its
interval while the page on screen does not need the stream (a combined app's member
that is not on screen still sees its new messages); proc gets its documents.

definitions.doc:
What the footer shows now, as one string: app-tick redraws the footer only
when it changed (a redraw also makes the screen be recorded again, which
every scrolling title would pay for)

definitions.name: app-server-name
definitions.doc: "http://host:port" shown as "host:port"

definitions.name: app-feed-footer-parts
definitions.doc: #(text right failed?) of the shown page's feed footer

definitions.name: app-carousel-config
definitions.doc: carousel = 1 in the app's ini (or config.ini [app]): seconds per page

definitions.name: app-set-url!
definitions.doc:
Page i fetches from url from now on (the URL procedures run once, at
app-define!); the page shown fetches it at once

definitions.name: app-carousel-state
definitions.doc:
From the REPL (WebREPL quick commands "暂停翻页" / "恢复翻页"): the carousel
stops on this page, or counts it from the start again. Short presses still
turn pages. => paused, running, or off (no carousel = 1 in the app's ini).

definitions.name: app-carousel-held
definitions.doc:
One second of the carousel: the next page when this one's time is up. A page whose app
cycles through its own screens (app-hold-proc) keeps it waiting, and is left as soon as
its cycle went round.

definitions.name: app-tick
definitions.sig: (app-tick hm sec week date lux bl . rest)

definitions.name: app-button
definitions.doc:
Short press: next page (the home page after the last; a carousel's
countdown starts again there). A long press opens the hardware pages
(apps/lib/infopages.scm, shared by every app); the carousel's countdown
starts again when they open and close.

definitions.name: app-alerts
definitions.doc: #(id owner app title render ack priority exit seconds snooze seq left wake full)

definitions.name: app-alert-clock
definitions.doc: seconds since the start (snoozes wake on it)

definitions.name: app-alert-done-ids
definitions.doc: alerts that ended: raising one again does nothing

definitions.name: app-alert-user-button
definitions.doc: the app's own presses (app-define! wraps them)

definitions.name: app-alert-owner
definitions.doc:
A combined app's hooks (combo.scm): which member raises an alert, running code as that
member, its name and its settings. Alone, the app itself.

definitions.name: app-alert-setting
definitions.doc: runs inside app-alert-run

definitions.name: app-callback
definitions.doc:
A callback the firmware calls later (fs-download's on-done): it runs as the code that made it
(in a combined app, as that member: its folder, its settings)

definitions.name: app-alert-value
definitions.doc: One setting: the user's (as text), else the app's option, else the default

definitions.name: app-alert-insert
definitions.doc: The queue with a in its place: a higher priority first, then the one that came first

definitions.name: app-alert-current
definitions.doc: The alert on screen: the first one not put off, or #f

definitions.name: app-alert-end!
definitions.doc: The alert leaves the queue for good (its ack first when confirmed)

definitions.name: app-alert-done!
definitions.doc: The app ends its alert (every dose taken, the message read elsewhere)

definitions.name: app-alert-press!
definitions.doc: Short press on an alert: its ack; it closes unless only time ends it, or the app does

definitions.name: app-alert-snooze!
definitions.doc: Long press: put off for its snooze minutes; it comes back with its full seconds

definitions.name: app-alert-tick!
definitions.doc: Every second: alerts put off come back; the one on screen counts down when time ends it

definitions.name: app-alert-wrap-buttons!
definitions.doc: The presses go to the alert on screen, else to the app (app-define! wraps them once)

definitions.name: app-alert-color
definitions.doc:
Screen: a title bar in the priority's color with the app's name and the alert's title,
the alerts waiting and the countdown; the alert's own body; a footer saying what the
presses do

definitions.name: app-watches
definitions.doc: Watched feeds: #(url-proc interval owner proc due), due on app-alert-clock

definitions.name: app-watch-deliver!
definitions.doc: A document of a watched feed no page shows: to its proc, as its app's code

definitions.name: app-watch-step!
definitions.doc:
Every second: a due watched feed takes the stream while no fetch is in flight; the page on
screen takes it back right after when its data is due (app-take-document!, app-follow-page!),
also when its fetch keeps failing

definitions.name: web-hex-digit
definitions.doc: Percent-decoding of a form value ("a+b%41" -> "a bA"): bytes in, bytes out

definitions.name: web-field
definitions.doc: The value of field key in a form body ("a=1&b=x%20y"), or #f

definitions.name: web-field-int
definitions.doc: A field as an integer, or default

definitions.name: WEB-QUOTE
definitions.doc: The double quote character

definitions.name: web-json-string
definitions.doc:
JSON text of a value: strings, numbers, #t/#f, symbols (as strings),
vectors (arrays), alists with symbol or string keys (objects), other lists (arrays)

definitions.name: web-error
definitions.doc: {"success":false,"error":msg}: the page's appCall throws it

definitions.name: web-ok
definitions.doc: {"success":true, ...fields}

definitions.name: combo-members
definitions.doc: #(id title pages subtitle tick data long views empty ids defaults has-ini)

definitions.name: combo-pending
definitions.doc: (title . pages) of the member being loaded

definitions.name: combo-entries
definitions.doc: per page of this app: #(member local-page view-proc view-index)

definitions.name: combo-ctx
definitions.doc: the member whose code runs now, #f this app's own

definitions.name: combo-loading
definitions.doc: the id of the member whose code loads now (combo-loading!)

definitions.name: combo-name
definitions.doc: this app's title (combo-start!)

definitions.name: app-web
definitions.doc: a member may define its own: kept per member

definitions.name: combo-has-folders
definitions.doc: firmware API 1.13

definitions.name: combo-index
definitions.doc: this app's page index while a member's code runs

definitions.name: app-long-press
definitions.doc: a member may define its own: kept per member

definitions.name: app-define!
definitions.doc: A member's app-define!: recorded (combo-member! keeps it)

definitions.name: combo-nonempty
definitions.doc:
A member's setting, as the app gets it when it runs alone: its own
config.ini (a key empty there: config.ini's), else the default its code
gives; a member that never ran alone has no config.ini yet: its meta.ini
defaults stand in for it (as the file the firmware would write from them)

definitions.name: combo-folder!
definitions.doc: The member's folder for the paths of the code that runs now (#f: this app's own)

definitions.name: combo-loading!
definitions.doc: Before a member's code: its folder and settings while it loads

definitions.name: combo-in
definitions.doc: Runs thunk as the member's code: its page number, its settings

definitions.name: app-start-feed!
definitions.doc: A member restarting its page's fetch: this app's page, not the member's number

definitions.name: app-set-url!
definitions.doc: A member changing its page i's URL: every entry showing that page

definitions.name: combo-member!
definitions.doc: After each member's code: keep what it defined, clear the hooks

definitions.name: combo-char-pos
definitions.doc: The first position of character ch in s at or after start, else #f

definitions.name: combo-page-of
definitions.doc:
The page of member m called rest: an English page name, front, a number
(1 first) or the page's own name; #f when none

definitions.name: combo-parse
definitions.doc:
"weather.sevendays" / "stocks.front" / "wxpusher.news[0]" -> an entry, #f
when the app or the page is unknown

definitions.name: combo-all-entries
definitions.doc: Every page of every member, in order (entries left empty)

definitions.name: combo-entry-name
definitions.doc: The entry's name in the header: its page's name (and the view's number)

definitions.name: combo-entry-page
definitions.doc:
The entry as a page of this app: the member's URL, interval and render
(or its view), each run as the member's code

definitions.name: app-header-title
definitions.doc: Header: the entry's app and the page (or the app's own subtitle on its first page)

definitions.name: combo-data
definitions.doc: The document that arrived belongs to the entries with its URL: their app's data hook

definitions.name: combo-tick
definitions.doc:
Every second: the shown entry's app, and the app whose alert is on screen (a reminder's
time limit runs on its clock)

definitions.name: combo-step
definitions.doc:
Every main-loop pass: each member's app-step-proc, as its code; #t when one used the
feed stream itself (the framework's step waits)

definitions.name: combo-member-hook
definitions.doc: The entry on screen's app: whether it keeps the carousel waiting; its entry came on screen

definitions.name: combo-web
definitions.doc: The web page's calls: a member's page names the member (firmware API 1.13), else this app's own

definitions.name: combo-member-json
definitions.doc: This app's own page (apps/lib/combo_web.html): the members, their pages and views, the settings

definitions.name: combo-schedule
definitions.doc: A time of a member's schedule.ini came (firmware API 1.13 passes its id): that member's hook

definitions.name: app-alert-owner
definitions.doc:
Alerts and watched feeds (applib section 9): the member whose code raises one is its
owner (with the page its code runs as); its code runs as that member again

definitions.name: combo-alert-override
definitions.doc:
This app's setting alerts for member id: "id:priority[:exit[:seconds]]", comma
separated; #f where it says nothing

definitions.name: combo-start!
definitions.doc: The pages entries lists (unknown ones left out; empty: all of them)

definitions.name: combo-build!
definitions.doc: The entries (again after the web page changed them): this app's pages
